lessons.detail:
**Kanji track, to 500: four fifths of what you read.** From here the track is in frequency order, the commonest first: by the end of this module the first 500 characters are known, and those make up about four fifths of running newspaper text.

Characters 160 to 167 of the jōyō list, by how often they appear in text — with the readings they take and the words those readings appear in. Readings: on'yomi in katakana / kun'yomi in hiragana, with the okurigana after a hyphen.

| Kanji | Strokes | Meaning | Readings | In words |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 会 | 6 | meeting, meet | カイ・エ / あ-う・あ-わせる | 会 かい — meeting · 会う あう — to meet · 国会 こっかい — National Diet |
| 同 | 6 | same, agree | ドウ / おな-じ | 同 どう — the same · 同じ おなじ — same · 同日 どうじつ — the same day |
| 政 | 9 | politics, government | セイ・ショウ / まつりごと・まん | 政 まつりごと — rule · 国政 こくせい — national politics · 行政 ぎょうせい — executive |
| 自 | 6 | oneself | ジ・シ / みずか-ら・おの-ずから | 自ら みずから — oneself · 自国 じこく — one's own country · 自社 じしゃ — one's company |
| 議 | 20 | deliberation, consultation | ギ | 会議 かいぎ — meeting · 議会 ぎかい — congress · 議長 ぎちょう — chair |
| 民 | 5 | people, nation | ミン / たみ | 民 たみ — people · 国民 こくみん — people · 人民 じんみん — the people |
| 連 | 10 | take along, lead | レン / つら-なる・つら-ねる | 連れ つれ — companion · 連日 れんじつ — day after day · 一連 いちれん — series |
| 発 | 9 | departure, discharge | ハツ・ホツ / た-つ・あば-く | 発 はつ — departure · 一発 いっぱつ — one shot · 出発 しゅっぱつ — departure |

**Radicals.** Each kanji is filed under one radical, which often — not always — carries its meaning: 人 / 亻 (person): 会 · 口 (mouth): 同 · 攴 / 攵 (strike, action): 政 · 言 (words, speech): 議 · 辵 / 辶 (moving, a road): 連.

**Writing.** Watch each on Jisho once, trace it, then write it from memory before checking.

**Practice.** Write every word in the table by hand, then cover the readings and read them back.
